name: Motor Systems & Motor Control
summary: How the nervous system plans and executes movement, from spinal reflexes to cortex, basal ganglia and cerebellum: the core neuroscience behind exoskeletons and neural prostheses.

topics.name: Organisation of the motor system: hierarchy and parallel pathways

Motor cortex: maps, population coding of movement direction

Basal ganglia: action selection and reinforcement learning
Cerebellum: coordination, timing and error-based learning
Eye movements as a model motor system
Motor learning and adaptation: internal models
Computational motor control: optimal feedback control
Disorders of movement: Parkinson's disease, stroke, spinal cord injury
